details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B. The orchestrator poller and stall recovery (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C. The clarify, plan or implement phase workflows
D. Documentation only (README.md, docs/)
E. Something else: name the file, workflow or feature in your answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for the area you chose in Q1?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure: please link the failing run, issue or PR (RECOMMENDED)
B. Make it faster or cheaper (fewer API calls, shorter run time, lower token use)
C. Make it more reliable or safer (fewer stalls, retries or false alerts)
D. Make it clearer (docs, log messages, alert wording)
E. Add a new capability: describe the new behaviour in your answer
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A. A named failure (run, PR or log line) no longer happens, and a regression test pins the fix (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable target is met: state the metric and the threshold
C. A reviewer signs off on the changed docs or messages, with no runtime change expected
